comment: Game data the engine reads when started the way the FAF client starts it (/init init_faf.lua). Derived from init_faf.lua (FAF 3839) and the engine's startup code; see docs/port/gamedata.md. Nothing listed here is shipped with the app: SCFA files come from the user's own copy, FAF files from FAF.

layout.comment: Directories relative to the data root (Android: Context.getExternalFilesDir(null)). Names are fixed; the launcher and the deploy script create them.

tiers.required: Needed to reach the main menu.
tiers.recommended: Needed for normal skirmish play (units, terrain, sounds, the stock skirmish maps).
tiers.optional: Extras: movies, music, campaign content, other voice languages.

faf.comment: Pinned to FAF game version 3839. 'remote' is the file name on baseUrl ({v} = version). 'local' is the path inside a Windows FAF client install (C:/ProgramData/FAForever). The download path is public but undocumented; ask the FAF team before any public release that uses it.

files.name: init_faf.lua
files.purpose: Data-path script: builds the mount table (path/hook/protocols).

files.name: SupComDataPath.lua
files.purpose: Default script when no /init is given. Uses a backslash path; the Android launcher always passes /init.

files.name: effects.nx2
files.purpose: Shaders (/effects/*.fx); the engine dies without them.

files.name: schook.nx2
files.purpose: Not mounted by init_faf.lua 3839 (commented out); kept for completeness.

scfa.comment: Selections from the user's Supreme Commander: Forged Alliance install (Steam/GOG/retail). Each entry copies matching names directly inside 'src' to <root>/scfa/<src>/<name>. Patterns are case-insensitive with * and ?. kind=file matches regular files, kind=dir matches directories and copies them recursively. 'approxBytes' is from a Steam install (German) and only informational.

entries.label: Base textures
entries.purpose: UI and world textures FAF does not override (main menu backgrounds live here).

entries.label: Units, terrain, effects
entries.purpose: Base assets underneath the FAF overrides.

entries.label: Sound effects
entries.purpose: XACT global settings and the core sound banks.

entries.label: Sample mods, music archive
entries.purpose: Mounted when present; not needed for play.

entries.label: Movie and briefing sound
entries.purpose: Background audio for movies and campaign briefings.

entries.label: Other voice languages
entries.purpose: Voice sets for other languages (for example DE).

entries.label: Movies
entries.purpose: Menu, loading, intro, credits and campaign movies. Start with /nomovie without them.

entries.label: Startup splash
entries.purpose: Startup splash image read from the launch directory.

neverCopy: gamedata/lua.scd, mohodata.scd, moholua.scd, schook.scd, editor.scd, ambience.scd: disabled by init_faf.lua (replaced by FAF's lua.nx2)
gamedata/loc_*.scd: mounted but fully shadowed by FAF's loc.nx2
bin/*.exe, *.dll and DirectX/: Windows binaries, not game data

user.comment: Optional content from the user's FAF vault (custom_vault_path). Copied to <root>/vault/{maps,mods}/<name>.

faPathLua.comment: Written to <root>/faf/fa_path.lua by the launcher before every start and by the deploy script. init_faf.lua reads it with dofile(InitFileDir .. '/../fa_path.lua'). Paths use forward slashes and are absolute on the device.
faPathLua.template:
fa_path = "{root}/scfa"
custom_vault_path = "{root}/vault"
GameType = "faf"
GameVersion = "{version}"
ClientVersion = "{client}"
ForceAffinity = false
